# GitHub Copilot Instructions

See `AGENTS.md` for the project-specific AI coding guidance.

## What to know
- This repo is an Astro site using `astro@^5.1.2` with `@astrojs/react`.
- The main content lives in `src/pages`, `src/layouts`, and `src/components`.
- Form submission depends on `public/api/mail/index.php` and `src/clients/`.
- Keep changes minimal and consistent with existing Astro + React component patterns.
